steps.title: Open the PhilGEPS notice and confirm the facts
sub: Budget, award amount, dates, awardee and location match this page.

steps.title: Ask for or find the bid documents and the abstract of bids
sub: Local governments post them on PhilGEPS or their own website; the Bids and Awards Committee keeps the abstract of bids.

steps.title: Verify the risk: Contractor history and performance
sub: Open the bidders' earlier contracts listed below and read why any of them ended early.

steps.title: Verify the risk: Contractor ownership, affiliation and bidding networks
sub: Open each source and confirm it names this firm; look for an official record (SEC, COA, Ombudsman) that confirms the link.

steps.title: Check site and field evidence
sub: Check the site before work starts: satellite imagery of the stretch, earlier contracts on the same road, and whether a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, a TPM civil-society partner) can take geotagged photos later.
